# Overview

`Edge_Score2D()` performs miRNA gene interaction (MGI) enrichment
analysis by scoring each pathway on how unexpectedly its MGIs cluster in
a two dimensional miRNA by gene score space, relative to randomly drawn
MGI sets of the same size. Significance is assessed by its own
permutation test, controlled by the `iter` argument, with an optional
`seed` for reproducibility.

This vignette uses the same toy BLCA example data as the package's main
Quick Start vignette. See `vignette("miREA")` for a description of that
data and for running all nine methods together through `miREA()`.

# Required inputs

* `pathway`, a three column data frame with columns `pathway`, `miRNA`,
  and `gene`.
* `mir_DEdata`, a four column data frame with columns `miRNA`,
  `log2FoldChange`, `stat`, and `padj`.
* `gene_DEdata`, a four column data frame with columns `gene`,
  `log2FoldChange`, `stat`, and `padj`.
* `mir_mat` and `gene_mat`, raw expression matrices with samples as
  columns, used to score each MGI.
* `scoreFun`, the transform applied to the miRNA and gene scores, for
  example `"rank"`.
* `background_MGI`, a two column data frame with columns `miRNA` and
  `gene`, or `NULL` to use the bundled default (see `vignette("miREA")`,
  Step 1, for details on `background_MGI`).
* `background` for `Edge_Score2D()` itself, a character vector of
  background MGIs formatted as `[miRNA]:[gene]`.
* `iter`, the number of permutations. The function default is 1000. This
  vignette uses `iter = 10` to keep build time short on the small toy
  dataset.
* `seed`, an optional integer for reproducible permutation draws.

```{r load-data}
library(miREA)
data(toy_pathway)
data(toy_mir_DEdata)
data(toy_gene_DEdata)
data(toy_gene_mat)
data(toy_mir_mat)
data(background_MGI)
```

# Run Edge-Score2D

```{r prepare-input}
input_data <- getAllInputData(
    methods = "Edge_Score2D",
    pathway = toy_pathway,
    mir_DEdata = toy_mir_DEdata,
    gene_DEdata = toy_gene_DEdata,
    background_MGI = background_MGI,
    gene_mat = toy_gene_mat,
    mir_mat = toy_mir_mat,
    scoreFun = "rank"
)
```

`input_data$data$Edge_Score2D` holds the two dimensional MGI scores,
built by `getAllInputData()` from `toy_gene_mat` and `toy_mir_mat`
expression, transformed with `scoreFun`. `input_data$pathway$Edge` holds
the pathway MGI sets, derived from `toy_pathway`'s genes through
`background_MGI`.

```{r run-edge-score2d}
background <- unique(paste0(background_MGI$miRNA, ":", background_MGI$gene))
res <- Edge_Score2D(
    MGI2D = input_data$data$Edge_Score2D,
    pathway = input_data$pathway$Edge,
    background = background,
    iter = 10,
    ncores = 1,
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    seed = 42
)
head(res)
```

# Run through miREA()

`Edge_Score2D()` can also be run through the `miREA()` wrapper, which is
useful when you want its result alongside other methods' results in a
single `miREAResult` object (see `vignette("miREA")`, Step 2, for the
multi-method case). For a single target, `background` can be a plain
character vector instead of a named list.

```{r run-through-miREA}
result <- miREA(
    methods = "Edge_Score2D",
    input_data = input_data,
    background = background,
    iter = 10,
    ncores = 1,
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    seed = 42
)
head(result$result$Edge_Score2D)
```
